verdict.rationale: None of the first-party documentation in the pack gives the RTX 5090's TGP/TDP, its power-connector or PSU requirements, or cooling guidance; the NVIDIA pages cited cover only DLSS, RT cores, memory, and CUDA. Power and heat figures appear only in third-party reviews: TechPowerUp reports a 575 W draw on the 600 W 12V-2x6 connector, and Tom's Hardware notes the Founders Edition runs hot. These are independent measurements, not published specs from the product itself, so they cannot support a build spec'd on official board-power guidance.
